title: Chapter 1402
text:
Han Xiao sighed and calmed himself down. He shook his head and shook his head to get rid of his unnecessary thoughts.

No matter how vast the unexplored universe was and how many powerful unknown civilizations there were, it had nothing to do with him for the time being. The most important thing was to deal with the problem at hand. His focus was still on the war between the three Universal Civilizations and the World Tree.

As for the Iteration problem, it was useless to think too much about it now. He could not deal with it for the time being.

"Although I can sense the existence of the Beyonder's Vestige, I only know the direction. The distance is unknown. If that's the case, it's probably like finding a needle in a haystack."

Han Xiao pondered.

However, one's perception was dead, and one was alive. It was not impossible to calculate the distance. After all, the direction of one's perception could barely be seen as a straight line. As long as he kept changing his position, he could still vaguely calculate which one was closer through the deviation of the perception line.

However, at the scale of the universe, he did not know how long he would have to move to deviate the direction of his perception. It would probably be measured in Star Systems and Star Clusters. Although this method would take some time, it was still an effective method.

The only problem he had to worry about was that if the nearest Beyonder's Vestige was not around the explored universe, it would be a pain in the ass. The journey would take an unknown amount of time.

"No matter what, at least we have a preliminary solution to the three conditions. Let's follow this plan first."

Han Xiaoxin heaved a sigh of relief.

The three conditions were difficult and easy. The second one was the easiest. He just needed to inform Wuornos in advance and activate the Face Fruit. He did not know how long the third one would take. He decided to start with the first one and contact Wuornos.

Han Xiao immediately took out his communicator, found Wuornos' private number, and called him.

In the previous battle, the two of them had gotten to know each other. After the ceasefire, they had also exchanged private numbers.

The phone rang twice, and the projection of Wuornos appeared on the screen. He was wearing a solemn robe, as if his daily prayers had been interrupted.

"Black Star? It's rare for you to contact me. Why are you looking for me? "

Wuornos asked, his tone emotionless.

Han Xiao smiled but did not get to the point immediately. He said, "It's been a while since we last met. I suddenly miss you."

"Is that so?"

Wuornos' expression was calm and unmoved. He only looked at Han Xiao calmly and did not say anything. There was a subtext that said, "Are we that close?"

Han Xiao rubbed his chin and said with great interest, "Speaking of which, I've been curious lately. As the strongest person in the direct line of descent, why didn't Ethereal let you participate in the interception circle battle?"

"This is an internal secret. I can't tell you. If you're here to persuade me to join the battle, then forget it." Wuornos' tone was calm. "Do you have anything else?"

Tsk, so mysterious. Could it be that Ethereal was worried that you would die in battle and lost their national weapon …?

Han Xiao cursed inwardly.

Seeing that Wuornos' attitude was lukewarm, he did not continue to beat around the bush and raised the main goal this time.

"I'm looking for you because I have something to discuss with you … I want to borrow the Ethereal National Treasure."

Hearing this, Wuornos' eyes flashed. He did not immediately reject and asked.

"What do you want to do with it?"

"I want to try to break through to a new grade. I feel that the Ethereal National Treasure will come in handy." Han Xiao did not hide this goal.

"Oh? Are you going to try to take this step? As expected of the most talented Super in history … "

Wuornos' eyes lit up. He was not shocked but happy. He sized up Han Xiao and revealed an inexplicable smile.

He had always thought highly of Black Star and believed that Black Star was the person most likely to open a higher grade and break through the 'obstacle' in his eyes.

As long as a pioneer walked a path, the future generations would have a trace to follow. Regardless of success or failure, it would become an important reference for the future generations. Therefore, when he learned that Han Xiao was going to break through to a higher grade, Wuornos was very happy.

"From my personal point of view, I'm very happy to help you. Perhaps you can become a pioneer in the exploration of individual strength. I can also benefit from it. There's no reason to reject you …"

Wuornos smiled.

However, before Han Xiao could reply, he changed the topic and shook his head.

"However, the Ethereal National Treasure is not my private property. If you want to borrow it, you have to ask for the permission of the Arcane Church. If they don't agree, I can't lend it to you privately."

Hearing this, Han Xiao was not surprised and nodded.

"Of course, I understand. Help me tell the upper echelons of Ethereal that the conditions can be discussed. By the way, I also need you to help me put in a few good words and try to convince the upper echelons of Ethereal."

"… Okay, I'll help you."

Wuornos nodded and did not refuse.

Other than the upper echelons of Ethereal, no one could order someone like him to do things. However, seeing that Black Star was trying to break through to a new grade, he did not mind helping him.

The two of them chatted for a while more before Han Xiao hung up and heaved a sigh of relief.

The results of the initial contact were alright, and Wuornos had no objections. Then, he only needed to settle the upper echelons of the Arcane Church.

Of course, the upper echelons of Ethereal would definitely not give in so easily. He had to take out some chips that they cared about. Next, he just had to wait for Ethereal to come to him for negotiations.

…

On the other side, in the Arcane Church, Temple of Ten Thousand Gods.

After Wuornos received Han Xiao's call, he quickly contacted the Ethereal Pope and was very concerned about this matter.

With his identity, he could talk to the Ethereal Pope directly. Soon, the projection of the Ethereal Pope appeared on the screen.

"High Priest, what's the matter?"

The Ethereal Pope was a little surprised. Wuornos almost never took the initiative to look for him. Usually, he was the one who called to issue orders. He was a little surprised to suddenly receive a call.

Wuornos had no intention of chatting and went straight to the point. "Black Star came to me just now and wants to borrow the Ethereal National Treasure. I came to discuss it with you."

The Ethereal Pope was stunned for a moment. He looked at Wuornos in surprise and almost could not believe his ears.

"Lend the National Treasure to an outsider? Do you know what you're talking about? "

"Black Star said that the conditions are negotiable."

Wuornos' tone was calm.

The Ethereal Pope suppressed his emotions and asked with a frown.

"… Why does he want to borrow the National Treasure?"

"Black Star said that he wants to borrow the power of the National Treasure to try to break through to a new level of individual strength."

"A new level? You mean above Beyond Grade A?! "

Hearing this, the Ethereal Pope was shocked.

This was big news. As the leader of the current Beyond Grade As, if Black Star successfully opened up a new level of individual strength, it would have an unknown and far-reaching impact on the internal structure and the World Tree war.

In fact, because of Black Star's record-breaking growth speed, the three Universal Civilizations were all mentally prepared for Black Star to break through to a higher level, but they did not expect it to happen so quickly. After all, although Black Star was strong, he had only stepped into the Beyond Grade A realm for a few decades. He was too young under the lifespan of a Beyond Grade A, only at the stage of an infant to a teenager.

"… You want to help him?"

The Ethereal Pope's tone sank.

He had to ask for Wuornos' opinion before borrowing the National Treasure. Since he had come to help Black Star pass the message, he had most likely agreed. This made the Ethereal Pope a little unhappy.

Wuornos looked straight ahead and said calmly.

"Why not? Wouldn't it be advantageous for our side to have an exceptional expert? "

"That's true, but you know the significance of the National Treasure and the threat level of Black Star …"

The Ethereal Pope paused. Although he did not finish his sentence, the meaning was clear enough.

Due to the exposure of the truth of the Sanctum Revival, the three Universal Civilizations' fear of Han Xiao increased further. Although they did not want to fight internally, they did not want to see Black Star continue to become stronger, especially at an unprecedented new level. No one knew what level of strength this level was.

Furthermore, he had more concerns. During the exploration era, after the first Primordial One successfully broke through, the other Beyond Grade As popped up one after another. No one knew if Black Star would affect the other Beyond Grade As when he stepped into a higher level, the importance of individual strength would increase further.

Wuornos did not mind and said slowly, "Based on my experience, it's not so easy to break through to a new level. Black Star is still in the experimental stage. If he doesn't fail a few times, it's basically impossible for him to succeed. It's still unknown if the National Treasure can be used. The chances of his Promotion failing are very high."

The Ethereal Pope narrowed his eyes and did not say anything.

Seeing this, Wuornos paused and continued.

"… Therefore, I feel that lending the National Treasure might not give Black Star any benefits, but we will definitely be able to gain benefits from him."

"Then what do you think we should ask for?" the Ethereal Pope asked.

"I mean to ask for the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter to be unsealed. It has been sealed for too long."

"Hmm … it's not impossible."

Hearing this, the Ethereal Pope narrowed his eyes and fell into deep thought.

The Ten Thousand Deity Scepter had been frozen by Han Xiao with the Spacetime Amber a long time ago. It was originally taken away by the Radiant Federation and was returned in a joint operation. However, the research department of the Arcane Church was also unable to unseal it and could only look at it but not use it. Currently, only Black Star could unlock it.

Releasing this Universal Treasure was still somewhat tempting. This was a powerful weapon that could kill individuals. It was useful both internally and externally.

At this moment, Wuornos struck while the iron was hot and said slowly, "I know you're worried about accidents, but the National Treasure has already fused with me. Even if Black Star has other thoughts, he won't be able to do anything. The risk is very low. Furthermore, in the current situation, the chances of Black Star turning against us are very small."

As the face of Ethereal, he had a lot of authority, but he rarely gave advice and usually did not care about matters. However, at this moment, he took the initiative to speak up for Han Xiao. He really wanted to facilitate the cooperation between the two sides and observe Black Star's method of breaking through to a new grade as a reference.

Wuornos was quite curious. He had no clue for so many years, so why did Black Star feel that the Ethereal National Treasure could help him break through to a new grade?

He had owned the National Treasure for so many years, but he had never discovered such an effect. Could it be that the Ethereal National Treasure had some function that he did not understand?

…

In the Underworld Dimension, a light flashed, and Han Xiao teleported here.

At this moment, the two sisters were not here. Hella was cultivating in the Soul Terminal. At first, Aurora was still stubborn and focused on her cultivation. Later on, she could not help but go to the Soul Terminal together, letting Hella cultivate while supervising her special training.

Therefore, of the four Beyond Grade A officers of the army, three were in the Soul Terminal. Only Lothaire stayed outside to train Carrott.

Han Xiao activated the Beyonder's Vestige vision and quickly glanced at the Underworld.

"There's no Beyonder's Vestige here … Looks like I'm overthinking. I'll check with Hella and the others later."

Han Xiao shook his head and sighed. He did not have much hope.

After he finished chatting with Wuornos, he immediately came here to look for clues. He planned to start with the people around him. If the people around him did not have the Beyonder's Vestige, he would calculate the location.

Beep beep beep!

At this moment, the communicator rang again. It was a call from Wuornos.

"You're calling back so quickly? How many minutes has it been? "

Han Xiao raised his brows and picked up the call.

Wuornos appeared on the screen and said, "Black Star, the Arcane Church wishes to make a deal with you. I can lend you the National Weapon once, but you have to undo the seal on the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. At the same time, the next three Sanctum Revivals will be free."

"Woah, three times for free is too much. I'm only borrowing the National Weapon once. This price is too high. I think unsealing the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter is enough."

Han Xiao actually did not mind the Sanctum Revivals being free a few times, but since it was a negotiation, he naturally had to fight for it.

Ethereal's request for the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was one of the few possibilities he had thought of. Because of the war and other factors, he had already planned to unseal it, so it was perfect to use it as a bargaining chip.

The two of them negotiated for a while and quickly reached a consensus. The price was set at unsealing the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter and a 30% discount for the next three Sanctum Revivals.

"Then it's settled. Let me know when you need to borrow the National Weapon."

"Alright, other than that, I might need your help. We'll talk about it when the time comes."

"Okay."

After saying that, Wuornos hung up the communication, swift and decisive.

Han Xiao put down the communicator thoughtfully.

"This guy is really efficient. He's also very passionate about higher levels, but he's actually so enthusiastic about helping me break through to a new level. Could it be that he wants me to be a lab rat … Heh, no matter what he thinks, as long as he confirms that the Ethereal National Weapon can be used as a 'stabilizer', the first request will be resolved. This is a good sign."

Han Xiao revealed a relaxed smile. Fortunately, he had the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter as a bargaining chip and had not used it. Otherwise, it would not have been so easy.
